details.direction: Start on Straße des 17. Juni between the Brandenburg Gate and Kleiner Stern; finish behind the Brandenburg Gate; city course through Berlin
details.distanceMethod: Official course page: 42.195 km. The official runners' course map numbers the route 1–42, while the event homepage also uses 42.195 km. No second distance figure is published.
details.elevationMethod: Abbott World Marathon Majors official magazine: around 73 m of climbing and 79 m of descent across the route. SCC Events' own course page lists elevation as 'tba' and publishes no climb figure, so this card uses the Majors figure and labels it as such; it is not an SCC Events number.
